control: The app securely stores sensitive data.
repo_note: Tokens in secure storage; embedded offline database holding domain/personal data has no encryption rule.

control: The app prevents leakage of sensitive data.
repo_note: Logs and reports carry identifiers only; backups, screenshots, clipboard, keyboard cache not addressed.

control: The app employs current strong cryptography and uses it according to industry best practices.
repo_note: App performs no cryptography of its own; relies on platform secure storage and TLS.

control: The app performs key management according to industry best practices.
repo_note: No app-managed keys; signing keys are build credentials (32 §5).

control: The app uses secure authentication and authorization protocols and follows the relevant best practices.
repo_note: Direct IdP auth with PKCE; all authorization server-side.

control: The app performs local authentication securely according to the platform best practices.
repo_note: No local or biometric unlock in the architecture.

control: The app secures sensitive operations with additional authentication.
repo_note: No step-up or re-authentication rule for sensitive operations.

control: The app secures all network traffic according to the current best practices.
repo_note: Edge enforces TLS minimum and HTTPS; no rule banning cleartext in app config (ATS/network security config).

control: The app performs identity pinning for all remote endpoints under the developer's control.
repo_note: No pinning rule.

control: The app uses IPC mechanisms securely.
repo_note: Deep links, intents, URL schemes not addressed.

control: The app uses WebViews securely.
repo_note: No WebView rule; sign-in browser type not specified.

control: The app uses the user interface securely.
repo_note: No masking or app-switcher screenshot protection for sensitive screens.

control: The app requires an up-to-date platform version.
repo_note: No minimum OS version rule.

control: The app has a mechanism for enforcing app updates.
repo_note: Startup version check against a minimum supported version.

control: The app only uses software components without known vulnerabilities.
repo_note: Advisory gate and dependency approval cover mobile manifests.

control: The app validates and sanitizes all untrusted inputs.
repo_note: Downloads checked; server validates; no rule on deep-link or push payload input.

control: The app validates the integrity of the platform.
repo_note: No root/jailbreak detection (optional per MASVS risk profile).

control: The app implements anti-tampering mechanisms.
repo_note: No integrity/attestation rule (optional per risk profile).

control: The app implements anti-static analysis mechanisms.
repo_note: No obfuscation rule (optional per risk profile).

control: The app implements anti-dynamic analysis techniques.
repo_note: No anti-debug rule (optional per risk profile).

control: The app minimizes access to sensitive data and resources.
repo_note: Responses minimised; background location disclosed; no general permission-minimisation rule.

control: The app prevents identification of the user.
repo_note: Identifiers only in telemetry; no rule on device identifiers or analytics SDKs.

control: The app is transparent about data collection and usage.
repo_note: Privacy-policy link and location disclosure; store privacy labels not mentioned.

control: The app offers user control over their data.
repo_note: Deletion list per customer; no in-app per-user account deletion rule.
